### onlyAuthorizedExecutor

Modifier ensuring the caller (`msg.sender`) is registered as an executor in the registry.
Reverts with `OnlyAuthorizedExecutor` if the caller is not registered.


```solidity
modifier onlyAuthorizedExecutor() ;
```

### onlyRouter

Modifier ensuring the caller (`msg.sender`) is the bridge router.
Reverts with `OnlyBridgeRouter` if the caller is not the bridge router.


```solidity

```
